verdict.rationale: Stripe documents sandboxes as isolated test environments that let you test functionality without affecting the live integration. Multiple sandboxes stay isolated from each other, and the testing docs include a dedicated Billing testing pointer for subscription integrations. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, Billing-specific sandbox details (e.g., simulating subscription lifecycles) beyond a pointer, and evidence that the agent tooling (MCP/CLI) targets sandboxes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: A sandbox is an isolated test environment. You can use your sandbox to test Stripe functionality in your account, and experiment with new features without affecting your live integration.
Changes made in one sandbox don't interfere with changes in another
